c74object.name: evi.mattaverb~
c74object.digest: True stereo one knob allpass diffuse reverb
c74object.description: A simple allpass diffusion reverb with minimal controls interaction. True stereo input/output, no early reflections, designed wet and spacey but very dampable.

inlet.digest: Audio In Left / messages to evi.mattaverb~
inlet.description: Audio In Left / messages to evi.mattaverb~

inlet.digest: Audio In Right / messages to evi.mattaverb~
inlet.description: Audio In Right / messages to evi.mattaverb~

method.name: bypass
method.digest: In left inlet, bypass message to evi.gigaverb~
method.description: 'bypass 1' will smoothly bypass the reverb to dry.

method.name: pattrstorage
method.digest: In left inlet, pattrstorage messages to evi.gigaverb~
method.description: Prepending the word 'pattrstorage' allows you to send any message pattrstorage understands to the internal pattrstorage object - you can recieve pattrstorage output via the far right outlet.

attribute.name: damp
attribute.description: Not smoothed. Selects onepole (0) or twopole (1) damping filters in the reverb chain. Greatly affects the tone of the reverb sound.

attribute.name: drywet
attribute.description: Dry/Wet mix of direct signal and reverberated signal. Dry is 0, completely wet is 1.

attribute.name: size
attribute.description: Could be the only one knob control you need and much of the point of this reverb tuning. Small to large.

attribute.name: space
attribute.description: Not smoothed. Add damping filters into the allpass feedback path (1) or not (0). Interesting wet sounds can be made by turning off filter stages here.

c74object.discussion: For more information about other reverbs in evieve, see the 'evieve reverb' tab of the helpfile.
